sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Insanity for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Frozen for 40 seconds with a success value of 90.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 40 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: yourself. Applies Armament for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 50 when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 17000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Recovers 50 Cost.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 17000

[Blades Drawn] Setsuna or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
